title: Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst – Sales \& Growth Strategy** 




 Location: Tirupur (Corporate Office)
 



 Experience: 3–6 Years (Relevant analytics experience preferred)
 



**Role Purpose** 




 We are looking for a Business Analyst who can deeply analyze sales, market, population, and production data to identify new business opportunities, growth gaps, and demand patterns, enabling data\-driven sales and production decisions.
 



**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Analyze Primary \& Secondary Sales Data (Region / Distributor / Outlet\-wise)
* Identify sales gaps, low\-performing markets, and growth opportunities
* Study population, geography, income \& consumption patterns to predict demand
* Track existing product sales movement and new product performance in the market
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and new product launches in the innerwear category
* Map market demand vs production capacity \& SKU availability
* Identify overstock, understock, slow\-moving \& fast\-moving styles
* Support New Product Development (NPD) planning based on market feedback and sales trends
* Prepare sales forecasting \& demand planning reports
* Develop MIS, dashboards, and analytical reports for management review
* Support sales strategy, territory planning \& beat optimization
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Production, SCM \& R\&D teams
* Analyze sales team performance and provide data\-based insights \& appreciation reports



  





  





**Qualification \& Skill** 




 Education
 


* Any Degree (Engineering preferred
* MBA / PG in Business Analytics / Marketing / Operations – Added Advantag



 Technical Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of Advanced Excel \& Data Analysi
* Hands\-on experience with Power BI / Tableau / Dashboard
* Knowledge of Sales MIS, Forecasting \& Demand Plannin
* Basic understanding of ERP / Production Planning / SCM dat
* Ability to convert data into actionable business insight



 Analytical Mindset
 


* Strong logical \& numerical skill
* Good business understanding of FMCG / Apparel / Innerwear market
* Strong data\-driven decision\-making approach
